UPSTREAM: mainboard/google/fizz: Enable separate MRC cache for recovery mode Enable separate MRC cache for recovery mode. This requires change in flash layout to accomodate another region for RECOVERY_MRC_CACHE. BUG=b:69473883 TEST=Verified following scenarios: 1. Boot into recovery does not destroy normal mode MRC cache. 2. Once recovery MRC cache is populated, all future boots in recovery mode re-use data from the cache. 3. Forcing recovery mode to retrain memory causes normal mode to retrain memory as well. UPSTREAM: amd/stoneyridge/spi: Fix reads greater than 5 bytes This corrects a bug in 918c8717 "amd/stoneyridge: Add SPI controller driver". Pass a pointer to din to the do_command() function so the caller's copy is correctly updated. The bug allowed reads <= 5 bytes to work correctly (3 bytes consumed in the FIFO by the address) but overwrote data in the din buffer on larger transfers. Reduce palm zone width for eve There are many user complaints that they can't point near the edge of trackpad. The CL reduces the palm zone width significantly so that one can point near the trackpad's edge as long as the finger is ~>50% on the touchpad. BUG=b:68961892 TEST=manually tested on eve Change-Id: I7209cb3a2b13a23024fff58a04e590179e6f991d Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/781340 Commit-Ready: Tai-hsu Lin <sheckylin@google.com> Tested-by: Tai-hsu Lin <sheckylin@google.com> Reviewed-by: Wei-Han Chen <stimim@chromium.org>

login: Consolidate common storage/retrieval code Points all Store* and Retrieve* methods to the corresponding *Ex methods. Gets rid of a lot of very similar error handling code. The behavior should be the same, the only thing that changes is the returned error code that changed from kSessionNotStarted (user sessions) and kInvalidAccount (device local accounts) to a common kGetServiceFail. BUG=chromium:765644 TEST=emerge-amd64-generic chromeos-login cros_run_unit_tests --board=amd64-generic --packages chromeos-login Change-Id: I5e982d6a181e47a602fb72765a98e824ffbc72d0 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/719099 Commit-Ready: Lutz Justen <ljusten@chromium.org> Tested-by: Lutz Justen <ljusten@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mattias Nissler <mnissler@chromium.org>

hammerd: Update on boot only. This CL simplifies the update flow. Now there are only three update scenarios: On boot: - Update RW and touchpad if newer firmware exists - Update RO for dogfooder if new firmware exists - Show UI notification when updating RO or touchpad - Just freeze at Chrome splash screen when updating RW On attach: - Never update anything - Show UI notification to ask users reboot either: - RW or touchpad are broken - critical update exists (i.e. rollback number increases) Manually: - Always update everything BUG=b:65180379 TEST=FEATURES=test emerge-poppy hammerd CQ-DEPEND=CL:768339 Change-Id: If3ab968622f41787c89701efc5966fb7d1709068 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/768650 Commit-Ready: Chih-Yu Huang <akahuang@chromium.org> Tested-by: Chih-Yu Huang <akahuang@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Joel Kitching <kitching@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org>

Remove the one in chromeos board since it inherits the other one. Also revise some pylint related comments.
